# DeepSeek-Coder 1.3B Base

DeepSeek · released 2023-10 · 1.3B params · deepseek

**score 32.4** ±0.6 · #820 of 935 · from 12 benchmark results across 5 sources

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

<sub>[context source](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/deepseek-coder-1.3b-base/blob/c919139c3a9b4070729c8b2cca4847ab29ca8d94/README.md): Context length stated on the official model card.</sub>

<pre>
download          size  score

</pre>

```sh
# 4-bit q4_k_m
ollama run deepseek-coder:1.3b-base-q4_K_M
# 8-bit q8_0
ollama run deepseek-coder:1.3b-base-q8_0
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
